blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — MANILA, Philippines — The solar energy loan will be opened by the Government Service Insurance System (GSIS) to qualified pensioners starting Sept. 30. This GSIS move expands its financing programs for retirees as it observes National Pensioners Week.
